name: UCDP Candidate Events Dataset (monthly GED)
contents: Georeferenced events, identical 48-column schema to held annual GED. VERIFIED download: 10,051 global rows 2026-01→2026-06; 455 country=Israel rows, 847 best deaths (Gaza adm_1 375, WB 48).

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.quote: All datasets are free of charge and licensed under CC BY 4.0 — you are free to use and redistribute them provided you cite the relevant publications listed with each dataset.

fills_gap: kills UCDP's annual lag — unbroken coverage to 2026-06
traps: PRELIMINARY — revised/merged/dropped on annual fold-in; re-reconcile each annual release. code_status: only 6,619/10,051 'Clear'. Placeholder conflict_name 'XXX666' exists. country='Israel' labelling; Gaza/WB only via adm_1 (few blanks). API needs token; CSV needs none — ingest via file.

name: UCDP GED v26.1 annual — adds complete 2025
contents: VERIFIED: 417,968 rows, max year 2025. Israel-country 2025 slice: 3,190 events, 14,563 best deaths (Gaza 3,055, WB 120).
fills_gap: version bump on held source — highest value per unit work on this list; one file swap adds all of 2025
traps: ids and best/high/low revised between versions — RE-LOAD not append; diff against held table.

name: Israeli violence in Masafer Yatta (field-monitored incidents)
contents: VERIFIED: 2,904 violation rows / 1,799 events, 2025 full year, ~20 villages (Susiya 390, Umm al Kheir 293...). violation_type taxonomy incl. property invasion 1,546, threats 398, arrests 205, arson 166+81, home demolition 62. UNIQUE: police_behavior coded per incident (present-and-intervened-against-Palestinians 424; present-no-intervention 235; called-never-arrived 80).

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.quote: Except where otherwise noted, content on this site is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license.

fills_gap: the best open incident-grained settler-violence record found; police-response dimension held nowhere else
traps: Masafer Yatta ONLY — never present as WB coverage. Semicolon-delimited. Dedupe on id_event (2,904 rows vs 1,799 events). Village centroids on us. Continuity uncertain.

name: Airwars civilian harm archive (Palestinian territories)
contents: VERIFIED via API: ~2,705 Palestinian-territories incident assessments; 96 ACF fields incl. unique_reference_code, incident_date, bilingual location, lat/lon+accuracy tier, casualty min/max by children/women/journalists/healthcare, munition_type, named victims on pages.

license.name: NONE STATED
license.quote: checked /about/, /methodology/, /tool/, footer, raw HTML for licen*/Creative Commons — nothing

fills_gap: richest strike-level record of the current war — gated on a LICENSE question, not technical
traps: (1) NO license — written terms from Airwars required before any ingest. (2) API is a partial mirror: 2023+ Gaza records return EMPTY lat/lon and casualty fields while the HTML pages show them — full ingest = parsing ~2,700 pages. (3) Cloudflare 403s plain fetchers — browser engine required. One 19700101 null-date bug observed.

name: CPJ journalists killed database
contents: VERIFIED by full pagination: 212 journalists + 22 media workers killed, 'Israel and the OPT', 2001-2026 (2023=61, 2024=74, 2025=52, 2026=6). Fields: org, typeOfDeath (Dangerous Assignment 160, Murder 36...), sourcesOfFire (Military Officials 208), impunity.

license.name: CC BY-NC-ND 4.0
license.quote: Except where noted, text on this website is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial-NoDerivatives 4.0 International License.

fills_gap: richer than T4P's journalist list (source-of-fire, impunity) BUT NoDerivatives forbids reshaping into our schema
traps: ND is the blocker, not NC: serving CPJ rows in our schema is a derivative work. Written permission, or internal cross-check only. pageSize fixed 20; unknown params silently return 0 rows. No Gaza/WB split.

name: PCBS: Violations Against Education (students/staff killed-injured-arrested)
contents: VERIFIED: 360 rows. Gaza/WB × School/University × Students/Staff, Killed/Injured/Arrested as CUMULATIVE as-of snapshots ~weekly, 2023-10-07→2025-11-04 (e.g. Gaza school students 8,227 killed as of 2024-07-09).

license.name: CC BY 4.0
license.quote: Except where otherwise noted, content on this site is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International license.

fills_gap: only open, maintained series isolating education-sector casualties with Gaza/WB split; PCBS as citable authority
traps: CUMULATIVE snapshots — never difference naively (back-revisions); load as as_of series (exactly our sys_period shape). Cells contain '-'/'Unknown'. Google-Sheets-backed resource can change without HDX revision — snapshot on ingest.

name: ACLED terms of use — COMPLIANCE VERDICT on held-raw data
contents: Read at source. EULA: license is 'for non-commercial purposes'; 'Licensee shall not (i) provide, permit, or allow direct access to any of the Licensed Content'; 'It is not sufficient for Licensed Content to simply be supplemented, appended, excerpted, reorganized, or made available through Licensee's own dashboard.' Usage Terms prohibit 'any dataset, product, or platform that competes with, or creates a functional substitute for' ACLED, and any ML/AI training use 'regardless of whether such use is commercial, academic, or experimental'.

license.name: ACLED EULA + Content Usage Terms (proprietary, NC, non-redistributable)
license.quote: Licensee shall not (i) provide, permit, or allow direct access to any of the Licensed Content

fills_gap: verdict: ACLED must NOT be served from the databank in any form — raw, reorganized, dashboarded, or commercial. v2 verified ZERO ACLED rows (2026-08-07). v1 fetches acled-pse nightly and serves its site — [ZAID] compliance flag for v1.
traps: Transformative-only exception exists ('cannot be reverse engineered') — a high-level chart may survive; a queryable table will not. Paid corporate license is the only serving route.

name: Insecurity Insight — Explosive Weapons Incident Data (global, PSE slice)
contents: VERIFIED download: 17,930 global rows; PSE = 6,743 (largest country slice). Columns: date, description, admin1, lat/lon+precision, sector affected, launch type, explosive weapon type, reported perpetrator, infrastructure-damaged flags (food/water/aid/health/education).
fills_gap: explosive-violence at incident grain, open license, 6,743 PSE incidents — weapon/launch-type dimensions held nowhere
traps: UNCLEARED: (1) publisher already held — verify this thematic file isn't covered by existing II ingest; (2) xlsx parse showed column misalignment + literal 'censored' in PSE geo columns — coordinates may be deliberately withheld for Palestine; re-read with openpyxl before trusting any field. Share-alike viral. Dates are Excel serials.

contents: Quality measured on the 2026-08-06 19:30 slice: 1,180 global events, 9 geocoded Israel, ZERO Gaza/WB; 5/9 country-centroid; a Canadian campus story coded 'use conventional military force' and placed at 31.5/34.75 — a centroid that falls INSIDE GAZA.
